review.verdict: Two Lithiel wipes and an early trash collapse
review.summary: Completed in 43:50, over time, with 16 deaths and two wipes on Lithiel. The first three bosses were killed on their first attempt, although Rinse died to Zaen’s shot. The final boss accounted for ten deaths across three attempts, with imp casts, background Fire damage, wave exposure and Infernal contact in the recaps.
whatWentWell: Kystia and Xathuux were killed without a player death.
Rinse removed 17 Corroding Spittle effects; Huagh removed five Heartstop Poisons and six Curses of Doom.
improvements: Huagh: answer tank Poison stacks when your cleanse is available. DPS stop Fel Missiles; protect the tank from overlapping casts.
Rinse: move behind intact freight before the shot completes. Recover targets after reaching cover.

Kazzataur: keep distance from the Infernal and a clear gateway route. DPS cleave imps while preserving the Chaos Bolt rotation.
Prioritise remaining imps even late in the kill; Rinse heals from safe ground.
